newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada leading indicator rises 0.9 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: Canada leading indicator rises 0.9 pct in January.

text.p: The Canadian composite leading indicator rose 0.9 percent in January to 186.9 (base 1981) after a 0.7 percent rise in December, Statistics Canada said on Tuesday.

The indicator foreshadows economic activity by tabulating figures for sectors that rise or fall in advance of broader movements in the economy. The figure is "smoothed", reflecting a moving average of approximately the past five months.
The unsmoothed index, reflecting the past month only, rose 1.5 percent in the month to 191.2.
A Reuter survey of economists had forecast the smoothed index to rise 0.6 percent.
